seed_policy: Fresh random founders and fresh disjoint training/validation/final seeds; never resume a closed study.

family_policy.distance: Normalized mismatch on inherited gene loci; identical program genotypes never count as diversity.
family_policy.family_ranking: Best current training rank; deterministic ties.
family_policy.variant_choice: Farthest first from already selected family members; training rank breaks ties.
family_policy.fallback: Common behavior-diverse then fitness-ranked fill to exactly44.

archive_policy: Validation archives are preserved externally and never silently reinserted. Historical20 anchors remain protected in every carried arm.
audit_accounting: Separate measured wall/calls; never hidden in search budget.
additional_exclusions: Every later fixture/preflight and prior run layout, including all unqueried variants/poses.

data.training: Two matched contexts per generation: easy/short plus rotating prefix1/2/4 and genuine second-junction/alternative-cycle tasks,12inputs. Fixed common96-generation pose schedule.
data.validation: New broad independent contexts, all8poses, prefix0/1/2/4/8 with bends, real cycles, corridor and ordinary/nonisolated-disconnected retention controls.
data.final: A separate untouched corpus from the same registered strata; freeze/push all selections before generation.
data.planning: Exact context counts, grammar, schedule and timing-only sizing rule must be fixed during preflight before any validation calls.

fitness: Use only current training rows for reproduction; common paired-first lexicase/10%uniform parent mixture. No reward for genome length or family count.
primary_selection: Validation archive rank begins with complete prefix>=4pairs, then true-cycle pairs, all positive-prefix pairs and retention metrics; deterministic digest/identity ties.
before_launch: Integrate the prepared selector with a separately namespaced runner and complete mutation/RNG audit.
Freeze exact data grammar, validation ranking, controls and gates; calibrate unchanged production signatures.
Run a short end-to-end software preflight with discarded births; test protected identities, equal budgets, checkpoints and exact replay.
